requirements.label: 120 Total Credits
requirements.hint: The BM in Music Education (Choral) requires a minimum of 120 credits. Requirements follow the 2024-2025 Silent Advisor; SMTD students follow the curriculum of their admit year.

requirements.label: Non-SMTD credits (18)
requirements.hint: At least 18 credits must come from outside SMTD. First year writing, upper level writing, education coursework, and non-SMTD electives all count toward this.

requirements.label: Music Theory core (Aural and Written Skills I-II)
requirements.hint: THEORY 139, 149, 140, and 150, taken across the first year.

requirements.label: Music Theory: Aural and Written Skills III-IV (or Jazz substitution)
requirements.hint: THEORY 239, 249, 240, and 250, or the Jazz substitution: JAZZ 220 in place of Theory 239 and 249, and JAZZ 221 in place of Theory 240 and 250.

requirements.label: Theory 239, 249, 240, and 250
requirements.hint: Aural and Written Skills III and IV.

requirements.label: Jazz 220 and 221
requirements.hint: JAZZ 220 Basic Musicianship I and JAZZ 221 Basic Musicianship II. Jazz 220/221 may not be accepted as a prerequisite for some 400 level Theory courses.

requirements.label: 400 level Theory elective (3 credits)
requirements.hint: One 400 level Theory elective. Jazz 220/221 may not be accepted as a prerequisite for some 400 level Theory courses.

requirements.label: Musicology core
requirements.hint: MUSICOL 139 Intro to the Study of Music, 140 History of U.S. Musics, 239 History of Music, and 240 History of Western Music.

requirements.label: 400 level Musicology, Theory, or listed Jazz elective (3 credits)
requirements.hint: One 400 level Musicology or Theory elective, or JAZZ 460, 467, 470, or 479.

requirements.label: Ensemble (each term except student teaching)
requirements.hint: An approved Orchestra, Band, or Choir elected each term except when student teaching, seven terms in a typical plan. Repeat elections across terms count toward the seven.

requirements.label: Conducting (Elementary Conducting I and II)
requirements.hint: CONDUCT 315 and CONDUCT 316, 2 credits each.

requirements.label: Performance lessons (each term except student teaching)
requirements.hint: Performance lessons on the principal instrument elected each term except when student teaching, with completion of the 425 or 426 level; 2 credits is a 30 minute lesson and 4 credits is an hour. Seven terms in a typical plan.

requirements.label: Musperf 440: Senior Recital
requirements.hint: Zero credit senior recital.

requirements.label: Education courses (School of Education)
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule. EDUC 391 Psychology and Human Development, EDUC 392 Multicultural Society, and EDUC 402 Reading and Writing, 3 credits each. The planner catalog does not carry these School of Education courses yet.

requirements.label: Student teaching (Music Education 495 and 496)
requirements.hint: MUSED 495 Student Teaching, 7 to 11 credits, and MUSED 496 Seminar, 1 credit, taken in the final year.

requirements.label: Additional electives (6 credits)
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule. Minimum 6 credits chosen in consultation with an advisor; electives may be SMTD or non-SMTD courses.

requirements.label: First year writing
requirements.hint: ENGLISH 124, 125, or an equivalent first year writing course.

requirements.label: Upper level writing
requirements.hint: An upper level writing course approved by the Sweetland Writing Center.

requirements.label: Class Piano (completion of Piano 111, 112, 113, 114, and 205)
requirements.hint: Completion of PIANO 111, 112, 113, 114, and 205, or proficiency by placement exam. Choral students with Piano or Organ as the principal instrument must instead elect secondary Voice lessons with completion of VOICE 116.

requirements.label: Music Education core (Choral track)
requirements.hint: MUSED 111 Art of Teaching Music, 121 Technology for Music Educators, 131 Classroom Instruments, 201 Strings Methods, 340 Choral Techniques and Methods for Secondary School, 341 Teaching General Music in Elementary Schools, 342 Teaching General Music in Secondary Schools, and VOICELIT 200 Basic Lyric Diction.
